metadata.overall_summary: The recording begins with casual conversation among colleagues or hackathon attendees discussing hardware, monitors, and the helpfulness of Japanese staff members. They check the live transcription tool and prepare to conduct an informational interview with a member of the Recruit Global Talent Acquisition team. Once seated on a couch, the interviewer asks detailed questions about the interviewee's role in new graduate hiring, their campus visits across North America, the structure and size of the recruiting team, and the workflow of organizing events and collaborating with engineers. The interviewee explains the stages of sourcing, selection, and attraction, and outlines the informal and formal steps involved in recruiting internal engineers to participate as mentors in international events.
